messages.subject: Java-GUI within R
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,

I would like to call a self coded Java GUI within R and pass R command s 
from the GUI to R.
I know that DeducerPlugInExample does this by calling Deducer.execute, 
however this runs on my machine within JGR/ Deducer but not from a terminal.
Is there somewhere a minimal example how to do this? My own trials were 
without success.

All the best,

René
